name: Cardiff_Insane Letters
source:
An autobiography/autofiction of a month in Cardiff. 

In which we talk about gay sex, cigarettes and alcohol.

It also involves imaginary lovers and imaginary murders.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25914]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
卡迪夫一个月的自传/自小说。

我们在其中谈论同性恋、香烟和酒精。

它还涉及想象中的恋人和想象中的谋杀。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25914]引理软论坛[/url]]
